reversed_rule_order.tool_state: error: No tool named shell is currently available

input_linkage.interpretation: Idle reports session drain outcome; the idle ID is its own msg_ ID and does not identify which user input completed. Tool success/denial must be read from assistant tool parts, not inferred from idle outcome.

policy_tool_calls.tool_executed_field: The assistant tool part reported executed=false even when a harmless touch/fake CLI command completed with exit 0 and its temporary side effect was observed. Use state.status and state.metadata.exit for observed process completion.

messages.prompt_default: POST /api/session/{id}/prompt returned a user inbox object with delivery=steer when delivery was omitted.
messages.user_transcript: {id, time:{created}, text, type:'user'}; transcript ID equals the ID returned by prompt POST.
messages.assistant_success: {id, time:{created,streamed,completed}, type:'assistant', agent, model:{id,providerID,variant}, content:[{type:'text',text}], finish:'stop', rawFinish, cost, tokens}

queue_inbox.after_release: Messages contained both user prompts and both assistant turns; the observed drain emitted one terminal idle event for the queued sequence.

messages.provider_503: The local fake endpoint returned HTTP 503. Within an 8 second observation window OpenCode had retried (assistant retry attempt=4) and had not emitted terminal idle; do not treat the first provider error as terminal.

permission_rule_order: With [wildcard deny, specific shell allow] the shell tool was offered and the specific context/note commands passed. Reversing that order ([specific allow, wildcard deny]) removed shell from the model request. Rules are order-sensitive; use deny first, allow exceptions after it.

message_negative_controls: 503 retry remains nonterminal in bounded window

prompt_admission_observations.ack: HTTP 200 {data:{delivery,id,payload,sessionID,time,type}}; default delivery steer; ack user ID and payload text matched transcript user
prompt_admission_observations.queue_projection: queued ack ID/text appeared in inbox immediately; during 1s held-inference window it was absent from transcript; same ID/text appeared after drain
prompt_admission_observations.pagination: 12 message rows returned by 6 limit=2 pages plus one empty terminal page; unique paged IDs equaled unpaged IDs
prompt_admission_observations.response_loss: proxy received upstream HTTP 200 ack then dropped response; caller got RemoteDisconnected; supplied ID was in transcript; same-ID retry returned original ack and caused no new transcript row or provider call in the 2s observation
prompt_admission_observations.same_id_changed_payload: retry with same ID and different text returned HTTP 200 with the original text; transcript retained only the original user text
prompt_admission_observations.limits: one live server process and synthetic session; no restart durability guarantee; transcript absence bounded to 1s; no external inference or production effect
